related.title: EPON MPCP：授權公平性與 Jain 指標
related.titleEn: EPON MPCP: grant fairness and Jain index
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學峰值使用率不超0.8；搬移前失敗、後通過；搬移中斷需單獨列入驗收。 wavelength_load.csv與ONU搬移清單 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 0.9 與變更 0.6 peak utilization、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching peak utilization limit0.8: before fails and after passes; migration interruption requires separate acceptance. wavelength_load.csv and ONU migration manifest Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 0.9 and changed 0.6 peak utilization, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 本題等權教學門檻J≥0.9；第一組通過、第二組未通過；加權服務需另定公平基準。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. For this equal-weight exercise requireJ≥0.9: first passes and second fails; weighted service needs a different reference.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成4波長各10 Gbit/s，負載[9,3,3,3]；將第一波長3 Gbit/s移到第二，成[6,6,3,3]。 名義式 max(9,3)/10 = 0.9 peak utilization；變更式 max(6,3)/10 = 0.6 peak utilization。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 逐波長求和前後皆18 Gbit/s；畫熱點而非只報45%平均使用率。

合成4ONU額度[1,1,1,1]與[1,1,1,3]，單位都是kB/round，四者需求都足夠。 名義式 (1+1+1+1)**2/(4*(1+1+1+1)) = 1 Jain index；變更式 (1+1+1+3)**2/(4*(1+1+1+9)) = 0.75 Jain index。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 直接列每ONU平方與總和；將全部額度乘10後指標應不變，驗證量綱不變性。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic four10 Gbit/s wavelengths carry[9,3,3,3]; move3 Gbit/s from first to second, yielding[6,6,3,3]. Nominal max(9,3)/10 = 0.9 peak utilization; changed max(6,3)/10 = 0.6 peak utilization. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Per-wavelength sums remain18 Gbit/s; plot the hotspot rather than reporting only45% mean utilization.

Synthetic four-ONU grants[1,1,1,1] and[1,1,1,3] kB/round, all with sufficient demand. Nominal (1+1+1+1)**2/(4*(1+1+1+1)) = 1 Jain index; changed (1+1+1+3)**2/(4*(1+1+1+9)) = 0.75 Jain index. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Tabulate individual squares and totals; multiply all grants by10 and verify scale invariance.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Equiano：分支單元與容量保留
related.titleEn: Equiano: branching units and reserved capacity
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學峰值使用率不超0.8；搬移前失敗、後通過；搬移中斷需單獨列入驗收。 wavelength_load.csv與ONU搬移清單 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 0.9 與變更 0.6 peak utilization、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching peak utilization limit0.8: before fails and after passes; migration interruption requires separate acceptance. wavelength_load.csv and ONU migration manifest Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 0.9 and changed 0.6 peak utilization, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學保留量至少1 Tbit/s；原配置通過、擾動失敗，提出減承諾或增共同容量後重算。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching reserve minimum1 Tbit/s:the original passes and perturbation fails; recalculate after reducing commitments or adding common capacity.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成4波長各10 Gbit/s，負載[9,3,3,3]；將第一波長3 Gbit/s移到第二，成[6,6,3,3]。 名義式 max(9,3)/10 = 0.9 peak utilization；變更式 max(6,3)/10 = 0.6 peak utilization。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 逐波長求和前後皆18 Gbit/s；畫熱點而非只報45%平均使用率。

合成共同區段12 Tbit/s，三分支需求2、3、5；擾動為4、4、5 Tbit/s，不代表Equiano商用配置。 名義式 12-(2+3+5) = 2 Tbit/s；變更式 12-(4+4+5) = -1 Tbit/s。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 在分支前後畫流量守恆表，對每條共同區段分別求和；確認不存在把不重疊支路錯加到不同瓶頸。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic four10 Gbit/s wavelengths carry[9,3,3,3]; move3 Gbit/s from first to second, yielding[6,6,3,3]. Nominal max(9,3)/10 = 0.9 peak utilization; changed max(6,3)/10 = 0.6 peak utilization. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Per-wavelength sums remain18 Gbit/s; plot the hotspot rather than reporting only45% mean utilization.

Synthetic common section12 Tbit/s with branch commitments2,3,5; change to4,4,5 Tbit/s, not an Equiano commercial configuration. Nominal 12-(2+3+5) = 2 Tbit/s; changed 12-(4+4+5) = -1 Tbit/s. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Draw a flow-conservation table at each branch and sum each shared section separately, avoiding addition of branches that do not share that bottleneck.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
